description: Ministry of Water Supply - Constructions of Watapana water Storage Tank (MR 3) of Moraganaoya Zone of Medadumbara Panwila Interpreted water Supply Project, Laying of 315 mm Pipe Line from Dekinda road to Bawwagama of Galaboda Ella Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for water supply projects. It involves the approval of acquiring specific parcels of land (described in detail with boundaries, locations, and claimant information) under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. The content focuses on property acquisition and land descriptions rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
